svg.title: Five drills, each checked against a control run
svg.desc: One drillbook run on 2026-10-08. Minutes after the fault was injected. shop-api-scaled-to-zero (ShopApiDown): fired 1m45s, cleared +31s; shop-api-bad-image (KubeDeploymentRolloutStuck): fired 17m31s, cleared +30s; shop-api-crashloop (KubePodCrashLooping): fired 16m01s, cleared +5m31s; app-data-disk-full (NodeFilesystemAlmostOutOfSpace): fired 30m46s, cleared +33s; kubelet-stopped (KubeNodeNotReady): fired 16m30s, cleared +38s. Orange ticks mark fault injection; faint orange lines show the wait before firing. Orange segments span firing to clearing; blue dots mark clearing. Dashed orange lines show the control runs still firing.
